interpretation_boundaries: Installed configuration, hook registration, skill linkage, and an enumerated catalog establish availability; they do not establish that an ordinary task voluntarily discovered or invoked Loci.
The primary session has direct recorded delivery of the Loci index/MCP hint and ALL_TOOLS discovery instruction. It is therefore not an unprimed delegate surface.

The delegate record is a deliberate post-host capability probe. It cannot be used as evidence that an ordinary delegate found the tools unaided, and posttask inspection must not be counted as task-time discovery.

hooks.json registration and order prove configuration only. This inventory does not prove invocation timing, successful output delivery for every session, Loci engine use, Anvil behavior, or any scored-task answer, cost, or outcome.
